en.hubeali:
And by this chain – 
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘
The brushing of the teeth is a cleansing for the mouth and a Pleasure of the Lord<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 4. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: “He (the Imam) said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘
Brushing one’s teeth cleanses the mouth and earns Allah’s pleasure.’”
